fields.description: The grain every lead in this file is stamped with, and the field list the file is allowed to write. Only contracts the current user is entitled to are offered, and the grain is never taken from a column in the file.
fields.label: Contract

fields.description: Chosen only when the contract leaves programme open. One of the programmes the contract permits is picked here and applied to every row in the file.
fields.label: Programme

fields.description: The vertical, group and programme resolved from the contract are shown here once it is chosen.
fields.label: Resolved Grain

fields.description: The spreadsheet is attached here, as CSV or Excel. One row is one lead. Replacing the file clears the mapping and the validation result, because neither describes the new file.
fields.label: Import File

fields.description: The number of data rows found below the header.
fields.label: Rows Found

fields.description: One row per column found in the file. Each is pointed at a section and a field, or left blank to be skipped. A column mapped to a field this grain may not write is refused when the import is saved.
fields.label: Columns

fields.description: Validation is mandatory and is always a dry run: every row is written through the live path and then rolled back, so what passes here is what will be written. Import stays unavailable until the current file has been validated.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Validating
Validated
Validation Failed
Importing
Imported
Partially Imported
Cancelled

fields.description: Counted by the last validation run.
fields.label: Rows That Passed

fields.description: Their reasons are listed per row against the job, under Import Results.
fields.label: Rows Refused

fields.description: The file the last validation was run against. Import is refused when the attached file no longer matches it.
fields.label: Validated Against
